item.title: West Didsbury & Chorlton Women 3 Tranmere Rovers Women 2 : Match Report
item.description: Rovers suffered defeat in a five-goal thriller at the Step Places Stadium. item.title: Richie Smallwood joins Bristol Rovers on loan until the end of the season
item.description: Tranmere Rovers can confirm Richie Smallwood has joined Bristol Rovers on loan until the end of the season. Smallwood, 35, has made 32 appearances this season in the league, FA Cup, Carabao Cup and Vertu Trophy. The Club would like to thank Richie for his contribution and wish him all the best at Bristol Rovers.

item.title: Max Dickov joins Tranmere Rovers from Mansfield Town on loan until the end of the season
item.description: Tranmere Rovers are delighted to announce that forward Max Dickov has joined from League One Mansfield Town on loan until the end of the season. Dickov came through the academies of Manchester City and Oldham Athletic and started his senior career at non-League clubs AFC Macclesfield, Poynton and Stockport Town. item.title: Marko Marosi joins Tranmere Rovers on emergency one-week loan from Port Vale
item.description: Tranmere Rovers can confirm goalkeeper Marko Marosi has joined on an emergency one-week loan from League One club Port Vale. Marosi, 32, has made seven appearances for Vale this season, including five in the league. He can count Wigan Athletic, Doncaster Rovers, Coventry City and Plymouth Argyle among his former clubs. Marosi will wear the No.33 shirt.
